messages:
Alexa (AE): FYI I'm about to send our RFI package to LuminaHealth at 2pm PT. Need a quick sanity check on attachments + a short security gap list by EOD.
Devin S.: Copy. Which attachments are final? spreadsheet, capability matrix, pricing, SOW draft?
Alexa (AE): Exactly — main list: 1) capability_matrix_v3.xlsx (w/ feature weights) 2) redwood-rfi-answer-pack.pdf 3) pricing-tiers-v2.csv 4) PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md 5) security-attachments (HSM certs, SOC2 excerpt)
Marco (Security): Quick ask — are we including the KMS/HSM integration diagram and the key rotation policy excerpt? They asked about BYOK and HSM-backed keys.
Nina (Ops): Also add the network peering diagram and expected egress numbers per environment. Lumina wants an ops runbook excerpt for the PoC.
Alexa (AE): Good call. Marco @Marco (Security) can you drop a 1-paragraph answer for BYOK and a pointer to our HSM SLA? Need it in the PDF.
Marco (Security): On it. Draft: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via standard KMS APIs; for private/on‑prem installations we support HSMs (FIPS 140-2 L1+/L2 options) with documented key rotation and audit logs. For hosted customers, BYOK is available through our KMS bridge with per-tenant isolation." Will paste the short blurb in a moment.
Devin S.: For the capability matrix, I've added a new column 'serving-fallbacks' and a weighted score to reflect cost/latency tradeoffs. Link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/BUldG0k (permissions granted to the sales+sec teams).
Alexa (AE): Nice. Lumina requires a matrix row for: streaming responses, function/tool calling, dedicated capacity SLA, VPC private deployment, quantization guide. Make sure the matrix has Yes/No and short caveat cell.
Nina (Ops): PoC timeline question from procurement: can we prep a 3-week and 6-week option with clear gating? I'll attach PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md to the package.
Alexa (AE): They also asked about pricing ceilings for Dedicated. I'll attach pricing-tiers-v2.csv but we should annotate baseline commit & burst costs. Devin can you add a small example in the CSV (two sample commits + burst)?
Devin S.: Added two sample rows. Also included a note: `estimated tokens/day` and `expected latency SLO`.
Marco (Security): Blurb for BYOK & HSM: "Redwood supports BYOK via customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault). For on‑prem and VPC deployments, HSMs are supported with documented attestation and rotation processes. Customers receive audit logs for all key operations. We can provide a dedicated compliance package on request." Paste to file: security-bullet-01.txt
Alexa (AE): Perfect. rfi-bot can you confirm attachments uploaded to the Lumina thread repo and stamp with current hash?
rfi-bot: Attachment upload complete. Files: capability_matrix_v3.xlsx, redwood-rfi-answer-pack.pdf, pricing-tiers-v2.csv, PoC-plan-weekbyweek.md, security-bullet-01.txt. SHA256: 3a7f...9c2.
Nina (Ops): One blocker: infra provisioning for dedicated PoC requires quota approval in their account. We need Lumina to share account IDs and an IAM role by week 1. I'll add that as a gating item in the PoC plan.
Alexa (AE): I'll ask the Lumina procurement contact for the IAM role and an NDA-signed SOW placeholder. Also asking legal to fast-track the MSA addendum.
Devin S.: Small config snippet they asked for (embedding pipeline example):
```
model: redwood-base-2
quantize: int8
batch_max_tokens: 1024
cache_prefix: true
```
Add to the PoC plan appendix.
Marco (Security): FYI — they asked about FedRAMP controls. We don't have FedRAMP but can provide a controls mapping doc: `controls-mapping-lumina.xlsx` that maps our SOC2, ISO artifacts to their checklist. I'll start it and share tomorrow.
Alexa (AE): Thanks team. Action items: Marco — final security blurb + controls mapping start. Devin — spreadsheet final edits + pricing sample rows. Nina — add gating note for IAM/quota and network diagram. I'll bundle and send at 14:00 PT.
Nina (Ops): ETA: I'll upload the runbook excerpt and peering diagram in 90 minutes.
Marco (Security): ETA: I'll push security-bullet-02 with KMS endpoints in 45 mins.
Devin S.: ETA: Spreadsheet + CSV annotated in 30.
Alexa (AE): Great — if anything slips ping me directly. :thumbsup:
